page: UpCloud PREMIUM-8xCPU-64GB is a memory-oriented virtual machine deployed on KVM virtualization and driven by the AMD EPYC 9575F processor platform. The system is provisioned with 8 shared vCPUs clocked at a base speed of 2.0 GHz, matching 8 physical cores with single-thread allocation per core. Cache resources include 64 KB of L1 data cache, 0.5 MB of L2 cache, and 16 MB of L3 cache per core. Memory capacity is configured at 64.0 GB, establishing a substantial 8.0 GB per vCPU density. The configuration integrates 300 GB of local SSD storage and includes one complimentary public IPv4 address. No discrete GPU acceleration is present.

Benchmark evaluations indicate pronounced performance divergence between single-core and multi-core operations. The instance attains top-tier results in single-core stress-ng workloads, as well as in single-threaded gzip compression at 37.02 GB/sec and bzip3 decompression at 15.79 GB/sec. Instruction support encompasses AVX-512, AVX-512 VNNI, AVX-512 BF16, and hardware cryptography extensions like AES and SHA-NI. Multi-core performance aligns with industry mid-tier averages, demonstrated by a multi-core Geekbench score of 8584.0 and multi-threaded bzip3 decompression of 98.27 GB/sec. Large-block memory transfers achieve 87.41 GB/sec read and 45.45 GB/sec write throughput, whereas PassMark memory benchmarks measure within the lower quartile.

From an architectural efficiency standpoint, the instance bundles significant memory allocation and local high-speed SSD capacity within a standard footprint, avoiding separate block storage dependencies. A key operational tradeoff is the shared CPU model combined with modest memory subsystem scores on select synthetic suites, which may introduce latency variance under sustained multi-tenant saturation. The configuration delivers optimal utility for in-memory databases such as Redis, caching layers, medium-scale relational databases, data transformation pipelines, and web services requiring elevated RAM-to-vCPU ratios without discrete GPU acceleration.
description: UpCloud PREMIUM-8xCPU-64GB is a memory-oriented cloud server instance powered by the AMD EPYC 9575F processor platform under KVM virtualization. The instance provisions 8 shared vCPUs running at 2.0 GHz alongside 64 GB of system memory, delivering a high 8 GB per vCPU allocation. Built with modern instruction extensions including AVX-512, AVX-512 VNNI, and cryptographic accelerators, the server includes 300 GB of integrated local SSD storage and a public IPv4 address, without discrete GPU hardware. Benchmark evaluations demonstrate top-tier single-core compute performance and fast single-threaded compression throughput, alongside mid-range multi-core processing and Redis execution rates. However, PassMark memory synthetic benchmarks score in the lower quartile, representing an architectural tradeoff against total capacity. This resource profile is suited for memory-intensive workloads including Redis caches, relational database systems, ETL processing, and backend web serving.
